## History

Clair Donnell is one of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's pupils at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. During a classroom assignment, Clair writes a composition describing a tragic story where two individuals fall in love, become involved in a quarrel, and ultimately die of broken hearts. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later transcribes this overly dramatic letter alongside others in a correspondence to her friend [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md).

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P0](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0000), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P1](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0001), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P2](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0002), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P4](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0004), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P6](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0006), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P8](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0008), +47 more_
